answer: The mesa counter is kept in horizon and pigment publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 703 identities would post 3442 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
